articles.summary: On November 10, 2026, Horizon Quantum reported its Q3 2026 financial results.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Integration of OQC’s quantum processing unit (QPU) with Horizon Quantum’s Triple Alpha enables pulse-level program execution, qubit characterization, and gate calibration within a unified programming environment.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum and OQC Announce Successful Pulse-Level Integration of OQC’s Quantum Processing Unit and Triple Alpha Integrated Development Environment

articles.summary: Horizon Quantum today announced that they have signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Entropica Labs, a Singapore-based quantum software company specializing in error correction and fault tolerance.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum Signs Non-Binding Letter of Intent to Acquire Entropica Labs
